movelist.name: Muddy Water
movelist.effect: As a Shift Action, the user may Move to any open square in Muddy Water’s area of effect without provoking any Attacks of Opportunity. On 16+, the Accuracy of all targets is lowered by 1.

movelist.name: Calm Mind
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Ice Beam
movelist.effect: Ice Beam Freezes on 19+ during Accuracy Check.

movelist.name: Aqua Ring
movelist.effect: Aqua Ring covers the user in a Coat that heals the user at the beginning of their turn. The user is healed a Tick of Hit Points each turn.

movelist.name: Body Slam
movelist.effect: Body Slam Paralyzes the target on 15+.

abilities.name: Drizzle
abilities.effect: The Weather changes to be Rainy for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: While in Rainy Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.effect: The user gains a Tick of Hit Points. Rain Dish may only be used while the user is under 50% Hit Points or in Rainy Weather.
